description: Kiểm tra đồng bộ REQ-IDs giữa requirements và code. v4.0.0: completeness & hardening — S1 canonical dual-write fix (Step 6.2c CDG), W003 full data flow, error code renumbering per-phase (19E+3W); S2 PARTIAL_FEATURES schema docs, actionable-checklist.md contract entry, produces_for/consumes_from completeness; S3 3 consumer flags (--from-add-scope, --from-manage-change, --from-preflight) + registry_changes capture (F10); S4 bash script delegation (5 scripts + _shared/ split); S5 safety hardening (7 fixes: to_epoch sentinel, heartbeat zombie guard, NTFS atomic append, TOCTOU mkdir claim, disown detection, migration rollback, lock path docs); S6 POST-GATE (vs-postgate-check.sh T1→T4 validation + 8 evals). v3.3.0: audit fixes — verdict sync (PARTIAL_FEATURES + priority override), W002/W003 accounting, registry backup, Comment Style Map, exclude patterns, step reordering. v3.2.0: W003 feature-aware REQ-ID downgrade. v3.1.0: fix verdict READY. v3.0.0: session isolation + lock/heartbeat + JSONL index + dual-write canonical + impact artifact.

session_isolation.notes: v3.0+ session isolation. Lock per session dir. Heartbeat auto-exit sau 1440 updates (12h). JSONL index concurrent-safe qua temp+mv atomic append.

code_intelligence.pattern: PRE-GATE detection (Na/Nb) + CI-ROUTE Phase 2 REQ-ID search + Phase 3 cross-reference
ci_tasks: find_by_annotation (Phase 2: GitNexus cypher REQ-ID search + Serena find_references)
cross_validate (Phase 2: so sanh CI results vs Grep fallback)
find_references (Phase 3: Serena per REQ-ID + GitNexus context)
code_intelligence.graceful_degradation: Lock held → fallback Grep. Tool unavailable → fallback Grep/Glob. Zero regression.
code_intelligence.notes: Serena results are real-time (LSP), GitNexus cypher may be stale if index behind HEAD. Prefer Serena for precision, GitNexus for graph traversal.
